blogTitle: STICK FURY production blog (ep 8: 2,214 frames down, a lot to go)
about: ok so im nick. i make STICK FURY. its a stick figure fight series, 7 episodes out, all frame by frame, zero tweens, drawn with a mouse (a ball mouse. i clean it weekly). episode 7 is on the portal right now with a 3.41 out of 5 and i check it roughly every 4 minutes. story: a stick named kaze fights THE ERASER, a giant pink eraser who is erasing the stick world one guy at a time. every sound effect is my little sister pip (shes 8) making noises into a $6 headset mic and she gets first credit, thats in her contract (fruit snacks). i animate at lunch in computer lab B bc thats the computer with flash on it. if u watched it, vote 5. if u voted 2, i know. i dont know who. but i know.
aboutMore: we dont talk about episode 4. it got blammed in 11 minutes. somebody wrote 'my eyes' and that was the whole review. i replied 'thanks for watching' bc i reply to every review, thats the rule, even the zeros. then i went and drew 300 frames out of spite and that became episode 5, which hit daily 4th and is the best day i have had as a person. so really episode 4 was important. but we dont talk about it.
meet: Who I'd like to meet: the guy who made the stick fights that made me want to do this (i watched them in 5th grade on my uncles computer and never recovered). whoever voted 0 on episode 6 at 3:14 pm on a tuesday. the person who runs the portal, to say thank u and also ask about my score. and a hand. just one hand that i can actually draw.

interests.Music: whatever is in the audio portal under 'techno' and loops clean, dragonforce, the prodigy, the mortal kombat theme (ep 2 used it. everyone uses it. i get it now), video game music, pips mouth noises (all of ep 7)
interests.Movies: the matrix (the lobby scene is basically a stick fight with coats on), kung fu hustle, crouching tiger hidden dragon, anything with jackie chan, the incredibles, spirited away (i watch it to feel bad about my backgrounds)
interests.Television: samurai jack (the greatest. barely any talking. just LINES), avatar the last airbender, dragon ball z (ep 3 of stick fury is 40% powering up, i learned from the best), teen titans
interests.Books: the animators survival kit (library copy, renewed 9 times, the librarian has stopped asking), flash for dummies, a flipbook i drew in the corner of my math book (ep 0. unreleased. the true pilot)
interests.Heroes: my sister pip (sound dept), whoever drew the first stick fight, the lab B librarian for the lunch pass, samurai jack, the 9 ppl who voted 5 on episode 5 at launch. i think about u

blog.title: STICK FURY 8 production log: week 3
blog.body: frames done: 2,214. frames redone bc i hated them: 600. lunches skipped: 14. ok so heres where we are. scene 1 (kaze wakes up, the sky is half erased) is done and its the best thing i have ever drawn, which means in a month i will hate it. scene 2 is the bridge fight. the bridge is a line. the fight is on the line. THE ERASER erases the line from both ends so they have to fight toward the middle, and thats either genius or a thing i came up with bc i didnt want to draw a background. pip recorded 31 new sounds on saturday. the best one is 'eraser footstep,' which is her slapping a piece of bologna on the counter. mom was not happy about the bologna. the take was perfect tho so it stays. remaining problem: lab B closes at 4:15 and the fight gets good at around 4:10 every single day. i asked for a key. the answer was a laugh.

blog.title: what i learned from getting blammed (ok fine we can talk about episode 4)
blog.mood: at peace (3.41 out of 5 at peace)
blog.body: episode 4 lasted 11 minutes on the portal. i know bc i was refreshing. it went 2.1, 1.8, 1.4, gone. the one review said 'my eyes.' and look. he wasnt wrong. i had just found the gradient tool and i used it on everything. the sky was a gradient. the ground was a gradient. kaze, who is a stick, was a gradient. it looked like a fight inside a sunset. so heres what i learned. 1) one new tool per episode, max. 2) if pip says 'i cant tell which one is the good guy,' she is the test audience and she is right. 3) u can reply 'thanks for watching' to a guy who said 'my eyes' and feel ok about it by dinner. 4) episode 5 got daily 4th and it only exists bc i was mad. so thank u, my eyes guy. the file is still on my usb drive. nobody gets to see it. except pip. she asks for it when shes sad bc it makes her laugh.
